title: Cboe VX* cross-check of cm30_blind_iv (ADR 0003 validation items 1 and 3)
data_policy: aggregates only: no VX* value per day or per event and no volatility_history value per day (ADR 0001 §7, data model §2.1)
provisional: Bar iv is provisional: day 0 follows ADR 0002 and rests on the calendar's timing label for 2 of the 34 events (timing_status not_checked); it moves when a label is corrected.

volatility_history.source: post-no-preference/options volatility_history.iv_current, read in the private mirror

bootstrap.scheme: moving blocks over the session axis, not circular; one draw per block length, shared by every name and the pooled statistics (D2)
bootstrap.events: bar iv: events resampled with replacement, 10,000 reps, the same seed

bar_i.statistic: Pearson r of primary dln VX on dln ours (lag 0)

bar_ii.statistic: OLS slope of primary dln VX on dln ours, and the reverse slope

exploratory_adr_band.label: exploratory, not pre-registered (D12): ADR 0003's 'How we'll know it's wrong' reads a slope outside [0.8, 1.2] as a failure

bar_iii.statistic: level spread VX close − 100 × ours, vol points, every session with both values
bar_iii.rule: pass when every calendar year's median is within 2.0 vol points of the all-days median

bar_iv.statistic: R = mean dln VX(−1→0) / mean dln ours(−1→0), primary-sample events of the five names
bar_iv.provisional: Bar iv is provisional: day 0 follows ADR 0002 and rests on the calendar's timing label for 2 of the 34 events (timing_status not_checked); it moves when a label is corrected.
bar_iv.per_name: not computed: 6 to 8 events per name; R is pooled only, and a per-name aggregate over fewer than 10 events would count as per-event data (D8)

alignment_falsifier.statistic: pooled r of primary changes with Cboe moved by L sessions
alignment_falsifier.note: the bars are judged at lag 0 whatever this shows

secondary.statistic: bars i and ii on changes over gaps of more than one session (no verdict, D11)

maturity.interpolation: our blind rule (termstructure.interpolate: linear in total variance, at most 10 sessions of extrapolation; one expiry: flat sigma); at 21 sessions it equals cm30_blind_iv on every day

sensitivity_all_days.label: exploratory, not pre-registered: each horizon on all its own days

extrapolated.label: exploratory, not pre-registered: days with a horizon value and an iv_current whose horizon lies before the first or after the last listed expiry

calendar_30.label: exploratory, not pre-registered
calendar_30.interpolation: total variance linear in calendar days between the listed expiries that bracket 30 days (no extrapolation), IV = sqrt(365 w / 30)

exploratory.label: exploratory, not pre-registered
exploratory.why: Cboe's index counts calendar days and ours counts sessions, so a change across a weekend moves the two differently; and our snapshots were taken on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays until August 2024

snapshot_calendar.statistic: primary changes ending on a Monday; before the daily era almost all are of this kind, because snapshots exist on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays

bar_i_tue_to_fri.statistic: bar i and ii statistics on primary changes whose later session is a Tuesday to Friday

bar_i_without_day0.statistic: bar i and ii statistics on primary changes whose later session is not a day 0
bar_i_without_day0.events_used: every event of the five names in events.parquet, whatever its sample

stepped_changes.statistic: non-overlapping changes over k sessions from the first shared session of the daily era; slope of dln VX on dln ours and 1 / reverse slope
